title: 5 fishermen nabbed for alleged blast fishing in Occidental Mindoro

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Five fishermen were arrested during a joint law enforcement operation for alleged blast fishing in the municipal waters of Looc, Occidental Mindoro, on Sunday afternoon. Personnel from the Looc Municipal Police Station and the local Bantay Dagat intercepted the group at around 5:30 p.m., roughly 800 meters off the coast of Barangay Bulakan, after they were reportedly spotted using suspected explosives while fishing. Authorities seized about 100 kilograms of assorted fish, a compressor and related equipment, fishing gear, two boat engines, and an unregistered navy blue motorized banca.
